title: eludite.editor.signature_help input
description: Show Parameter Info for the call around the caret (Edit > IntelliSense > Parameter Info, Ctrl+Shift+Space; typing '(' or ',' runs it with `trigger`). The tooltip shows the active signature with the active parameter highlighted, follows the caret between arguments and closes on ')' or Escape.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line to move the caret to first.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) to move the caret to first; 1 when omitted.

trigger.description: The character just typed that triggered Parameter Info. Omit for an explicit request.
